motions.name: Tambourine Loop
motions.observation: Raised rim hold with deliberate free-hand taps and small wrist shakes.
motions.interpretation: An authored hand attachment keeps the wrist neutral while the measured drum face points outward and its ribbon strips hang down; the free palm approaches the skin and recoils.
